text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text: Are you ready to climb this mountainーー!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna & Hello
text_block_list.text: YEAAAHーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This wild woman is Tucker Blair.
Wishing for umamusume to soar even higher,
she works tirelessly building training facilities.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Leave the exercise to me!
I'll work up a great sweat for ya!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Phew, heart rate's picking up, I think?
Good for burning fat, right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, with this level of workout load...
...Wait, oh my, Trainer-san!
Are you all right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between umamusume Tucker Blair and Light Hello,
and the ever-athletic Tazuna-san,
keeping up was a monumental task.
choice_data_list: S-Sorry... looks like this is my limit.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Mm, actually you did pretty well holding out!
Head up to the summit by bus first! Catch ya later!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, they sell famous
soft-serve ice cream at the summit♪

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I wonder if Trainer-san
is eating some right now~? Lucky~.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
HAH HAH HAH! Hey hey hey!
We came here to burn fat, and you're talking sweets?
Good grief, you bunch are hopeless!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: M-My glutes are getting really tight... I think?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
When climbing steps, don't haul your body
up with your thighs!
Focus on smooth weight shifting!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...T-This is... really pushing it...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Reminds me... of slope training...
From way back when...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't we... call it
a day around here...?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
R-Right... we're not
that young anymore, either...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Considering tomorrow's work...
We really must... pace ourselves...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text: HOLD IIIIIIIIIIITTT!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text: Why are you two settling so small!?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
For tomorrow? Not young anymore?
Who's whispering that nonsense into your ears!?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Reason!? Common sense!?
Punch that garbage out with your INSTINCTS!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: T-Tucker-san!?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
The more grown-up folks get, the more limits they set for themselves!
Restraint isn't the only form of wisdom!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
If you can't enjoy now because you're fretting over tomorrow,
when are adults supposed to have real fun!?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...!
T-That's... so true!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Saying things like 'moderate'...
Ugh, how boring of me!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Heh, now that's the look in your eyes I wanted!!
All riiiight! Unleash your instincts and KEEP UP!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna & Hello
text_block_list.text: YES MA'AM!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A while after riding the bus up.
While eating soft-serve at the summit,
faint voices could be heard.
choice_data_list: Ah, is that Tazuna-san and the others?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text: TRAAAACEEEEEN!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna & Hello
text_block_list.text: FIGHT! OH! FIGHT! OOOOHーー!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Ah, what a gorgeous view...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
How long has it been since I pushed myself
this stubbornly...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
There are breezes you can only feel
once you bare your instincts!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Thinking things through is important, but...
If you get too stiff and can't enjoy things,
life's a waste!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
...Well, enough preachiness for today!
Trainer over there, c'mon over! First, we eat!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Blair
text_block_list.text:
Dig into my special boulder-sized onigiri!
DAHAHAHA!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the clear blue sky, I stuffed my face with
an onigiri the size of my head. On the way back, feeling the
breeze of youth, the two of them carried me down the mountain...
